name: xerox-scream-pink-star
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a high-contrast black-and-white photograph blasted through a photocopier — pure bitmap feel, blown-out white highlights, crushed solid blacks, almost no mid-tones left.
· NOISE: violent gritty photocopy grain and speckle covering the whole frame, harsh and dirty.
· GROUND: no real background — the face fills the frame edge to edge in stark monochrome.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: a big flat neon-magenta hand-drawn star-burst / sparkle blasting across the image, plus scattered tiny hand-scrawled pink words floating over the skin.
· PALETTE: pure black and white only, with a single screaming hot-pink / magenta accent on top.
· CONTRAST: brutal high-contrast punk-zine look, raw and abrasive.
· MOOD: aggressive, cathartic, DIY riot-grrrl energy.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
